(On a warm, sunlit afternoon, the Dragon Valley seems unusually busy.)
Do I? If it looks that way to you, I suppose I must be.
strings.얼마 지나지 않아 이 계곡에 새로운 환수들이 태어날 걸세. 그래서 여러: New phantom beasts will soon be born in this valley. I'm making preparations.
strings.빗자루도 없는데 청소를 하고 계셨다고요?: You were cleaning? Without even a broom?
Haha. You were thinking of ordinary cleaning. My method is a little different.
strings.내 원래 모습으로 돌아가 하늘에 날아 올라가지. 그리고 날갯짓으로 여신께: I return to my true form and rise into the sky. Then, with my wingbeats, I spread the energy the goddess gave me throughout Adrica.
strings.나도 가끔 본모습으로 돌아가면 어색하더군. 이제는 이 모습이 익숙하긴 하: Even I sometimes feel strange returning to my true form. I've grown accustomed to this appearance...
Is there anything I can help with? It feels awkward to just sit around resting...
You always spend your time helping others. Ah, something comes to mind.
strings.포보스 지역에서 큐리링을 보았겠지? 큐리링은 원래 우리 세계의 평범한 생: You've seen the Curirings in Phobos, haven't you? They evolved from Prirings, ordinary creatures of our world.
strings.태초에 신께서 사랑한 생물이라 다양한 형태로 모습이 변하게 됐지. 의외로: They were beloved by the god in the beginning, and developed many different forms. They seem surprisingly susceptible to their surroundings.
Those that grow fond of money can even become as worldly as humans...
strings.큐리링도 원래는 평범한 프리링일 걸세. 누군가 귀엽다고 데려갔거나 마계의: Curirings were probably ordinary Prirings once, too. Someone may have taken them for their cuteness, or they may have fallen through a rift into the Demon Realm and become demonic while living there...
strings.그러면 다시 원래 모습으로 돌아가게 할 수도 있나요?: Can they return to their original forms?
strings.악마화된 곳의 기운보다 강한 곳의 기운이라면 가능하지. 아, 그러면 되겠: If exposed to energy stronger than that of the place that made them demonic, yes. Ah, that may work.
strings.환수들이 태어나는 시기는 아드리카에 맑고 깨끗한 기운이 가득하네. 큐리링: When phantom beasts are born, Adrica fills with clear, pure energy. If we bring Curirings here to live, they may be freed of their demonic nature.
Please rescue some of the Curirings commonly seen in Phobos and bring them here.
strings.환수들이 좋아하는 마법의 자루같은 걸세. 신이 아끼는 동물들이 들어가길: A sort of magical sack that phantom beasts enjoy. Animals beloved by the god like to climb inside. Even a large one like a Sequentia will disappear from sight inside it.
strings.큐리링도 신기한 기운에 이끌려 알아서 들어갈 걸세. 일단 20마리 정도만: The Curirings will be drawn to its mysterious energy and climb in on their own. Bring about twenty first so we can observe them. We can bring more later.
All right. I'll go fetch the Curirings.
strings.고생했네. 큐리링 아이들이 사납지 않던가?: Well done. Were the little Curirings fierce?
Not so much fierce. They kept rushing at me as though they wanted affection. It was quite a handful.
Prirings are like that by nature, but these little ones were frustrated.
strings.몽마들의 영향을 많이 받아서 그런지 상대에게 매혹을 거는데, 그대는 그게: They've been strongly influenced by succubi and try to charm others. I suspect they're frustrated because their charms don't work on you.
strings.큐리링이 뭐라고 하는군. 그래, 그래. 뭐라고? 우리는 아름다워, 귀엽지: A Curiring is saying something. Yes, yes. What's that? You're beautiful, not cute?
Hoho. They sound just like Veled.
Veled says that to you too?
strings.하하, 몽마들이 가진 아름다움에 대한 기준은 확실히 다른 것 같네. 그런: Haha. Succubi certainly have different standards of beauty. But why do you look so tired?
strings.마법 자루 때문에 공간은 많이 아낀 것 같은데, 무게는 어쩔 수 없나 봐: The magic sack saves a lot of space, but apparently it doesn't reduce weight. Carrying dozens of Curirings is heavy work.
strings.그렇군. 미안하네. 내가 그걸 깜박 잊고 말을 하지 않은 것 같아서. 어: I see. My apologies. I seem to have forgotten to mention that. Oh, Curiring? What is it?
(The Curirings approach Atkina, crying, "Curi, curi, curiring." Atkina responds with a variety of expressions.)
strings.큐리큐리 이 소리 밖에 안나는데, 대체 뭐라고 말하는 건가요?: All I hear is "curi, curi." What are they saying?
strings.나만 이렇게 좋은 데 있을 순 없다. 다른 친구들도 보고 싶다. 귀여움과: "I can't keep a wonderful place like this to myself. I want to see my friends. Ask the fool who can't tell cute from beautiful to bring them too."
You've got some nerve asking a fool for a favor, you little rascal.
I never knew a Curiring's cheeks could stretch so far...
strings.그러면 다른 큐리링도 구조해오면 될까요?: Should I rescue more Curirings, then?
strings.헌데, 조심해야 할 게 있네. 밖으로 돌아다니는 큐리링은 악마화된 상태를: There is one thing to be careful of. We can reverse some of the demonic transformation in the Curirings roaming outside, but...
strings.다른 종들은 위험하네. 그러니 그대가 보고 가능성이 있는 아이들만 데려와: Other varieties are dangerous. Bring only the ones you think can be saved.
strings.여신께서 인도하실테니, 그대가 이 녀석이다 싶은 건 이 자루에 넣어 데려: The goddess will guide you. When you feel you've found the right one, put it in this sack and bring it here. This one should feel lighter than the previous sack.
These originally came from Kali. Tremende brought them in its mouth.
strings.(메디아 님은 괜찮으시려나….): (I wonder if Medea is all right...)
strings.그럼 이번엔 좀 서둘러 주게. 이왕이면 새로운 환수들이 태어나기 전에 처: Please be a little quicker this time. I'd like to finish before the new phantom beasts are born.
strings.큐리링의 상태도 확인하고, 새로운 환수들과 같이 지낼 수 있는지 봐야 해: We need to check the Curirings' condition and see whether they can live with the newborns.
All right. I'll go right away.
This won't hurt, so stay still. You little rascal! There, that's it...
strings.다녀왔어요. 확실히 이 자루, 성능이 좋아요. 가볍고 튼튼하고 많이 들어: I'm back. This sack really works well. It's light, sturdy, and holds a lot.
Still, carrying it up the steep valley was tiring.
strings.계곡에 환수들이 숨을 곳을 마련하다 보니 그렇게 됐지. 이제 아이들이 든: The valley is that way because I made hiding places for the phantom beasts. Now, give me the sack with the little ones. Hm? They're quieter than I expected.
I gave them some jerky I bought in Lumen. That quieted them down.
That jerky is just right for the little ones. It isn't to my taste, though...
strings.(큐리링들이 자루에서 나와 두리번거린다. 그러다 먼저 와 있던 큐리링들을: (The Curirings emerge from the sack and look around. Spotting the Curirings already there, they tumble together and begin playing.)
Wow. They're even louder in a group.
strings.환경이 바뀌어서 적응 기간이 오래 갈 것 같네. 그래도 여기가 다른 곳보: It may take them a while to adjust to the change in surroundings. Still, this place should be better for them than anywhere else.
They certainly look different here than they did in Phobos or elsewhere.
Perhaps they feel at ease... Ah, I have one more request.
strings.이제 환수들이 태어날 시간이네. 환수들은 인간의 등장에 민감해 그대가 있: The phantom beasts are about to be born. They're sensitive to a human presence. Having you here could unsettle them.
strings.여신님의 심부름꾼이라 하더라도 이건 어쩔 수 없어서 그래. 미안하군. 대: Even being the goddess's messenger cannot change that. I'm sorry. Would you go somewhere else for a little while?
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. 그러면 어디에 가면 될까요?: It can't be helped. Where should I go?
strings.타르타로스로 가서 샤이닉을 만나게. 가서 새로운 환수들이 태어나고, 큐리: Go to Tartaros and see Shynic. Tell her new phantom beasts are being born and we've brought Curirings here. She may come if she'd like to see them.
She'll be delighted. I'll go tell her.
strings.그와 이야기를 나누면 안 되는 상황도 있는 겐가?: Is there some reason you cannot speak with the adventurer?
strings.(환수들이 잔뜩 있던 나무 뒤에서 천천히 메디아가 걸어 나온다.): (Medea slowly steps out from behind a tree crowded with phantom beasts.)
It has been a long time, Lord Atkina.
strings.저는 괜찮습니다. 아드키나…님은 괜찮으신가요?: I'm fine. Are you... all right, Lord Atkina?
There's no reason I wouldn't be. You're the one I'm worried about.
I know this wasn't something you wanted. Say no more. First, we must deal with Weiss...
strings.미안하군. 인간이 아닌 내가 이런 이야기를 하는 것도. 그때 인간의 일이: I'm sorry. A nonhuman like me has no right to speak that way. And for not intervening then because I considered it a human matter...
It's all right. I only hope you won't take too long. Please understand this.
strings.자네가 생각하는 신뢰의 크기가 얼마나 되는지는 모르겠지만, 늦어지면 늦어: I don't know how much trust you feel you need, but the longer you delay, the greater the burden on the goddess's messenger becomes.
strings.그래…. 그러면 샤이닉이 오기 전에 돌아가게. 샤이닉을 귀찮아했던 거 같: Good... Then return before Shynic arrives. You seemed to find her bothersome, so I'll erase your presence.
strings.귀찮은 건 아닙니다…. 그러면 이제 돌아가보겠습니다. 감사했습니다, 아드: She isn't bothersome... I will return now. Thank you, Lord Atkina...
strings.(메디아가 아드키나에게 인사를 하고 물러난다. 아드키나가 메디아를 보고: (Medea bows to Atkina and leaves. Watching her, Atkina gives a faint, relieved smile.)
There's no need to worry. It seems the two of them have become friends...
I'm bored. So bored. Even eating feels like a chore today.
strings.멜빅, 오늘은 정말 귀찮아서 그래. 자꾸 그러면 집사 바꾼다♡: Melvic, I really can't be bothered today. Keep this up and I'll replace my butler♡
strings.흐음. 샤이닉 님이 제일 좋아하시는 특제 카레를 만들 수 있는 집사가 또: Hmm. I wonder if there's another butler who can make your favorite special curry.
strings.어쭈, 멜빅! 많이 컸네. 요만한 걸 이만큼 키워놓았더니!: Oh, listen to you, Melvic! You've grown bold. I raised you from this little thing into all that!
All thanks to you, Lady Shynic.
strings.그래, 다 내 덕분이지? 어라…. %s, 언제왔어,: Yes, all thanks to me, right? Huh... %s, when did you get here?
What? Sniff, sniff. I bathe regularly...
strings.아주 재미있을 것만 같은 냄새야♡…라고 하고 싶었는데 반응이 별로라 재미: I was going to say, "You smell like something terribly fun♡" But your reaction ruined it. Anyway, did you come from old Atkina's place?
strings.맞아요. 아드키나 님이 샤이닉 님에게 알려주라고 하셔서 왔어요. 무슨 일: Yes. Lord Atkina asked me to tell you something. You see...
strings.(샤이닉에게 새로운 환수가 태어나고 큐리링을 데려왔다고 전한다.): (You tell Shynic about the newborn phantom beasts and the Curirings brought to the valley.)
strings.(윽, 샤이닉 님의 눈빛이 지금까지 본 것 중에서 제일 반짝이고 있어.): (Whoa. I've never seen her eyes sparkle this much.)
strings.악마들이 데려다 키운다는 큐리링?! 큐리링이 지금 어디에 있다고?: The Curirings that demons keep?! Where did you say they are?!
strings.용의 계곡에 데려왔어요. 아드키나 님이 그 아이들을 용의 계곡에서 키운다: We brought them to the Dragon Valley. Lord Atkina is going to raise them there...
strings.와, 내가 몇백 년 전에 보고, 한 번도 본 적 없었는데, 그 귀한 큐리: Wow! I saw them hundreds of years ago and never again since. Those rare Curirings?!
strings.정화시키면 그 날개랑 꼬리도 사라질까? 그러면 안 돼. 한 마리 데려와서: Will their wings and tails disappear if they're purified? That can't happen. Maybe I'll bring one home and raise it myself. I can treat it just as well as a demon could.
strings.(샤이닉의 귀에 아무 소리도 들리지 않는 것 같다.): (Shynic seems unable to hear anything around her.)
strings.멜빅, 나 뛰는 거 귀찮지만, 용의 계곡까지 뛰어갈 거야!: Melvic, I hate running, but I'm going to run all the way to the Dragon Valley!
strings.샤이닉 님, 그러면 카레는 언제 드시려고요?: Lady Shynic, when will you eat your curry, then?
strings.(샤이닉이 멜빅이 들고 있던 접시를 빼앗는다. 그리고 서둘러 음식을 입안: (Shynic snatches the plate from Melvic and hurriedly shovels the food into her mouth.)
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 샤이닉이 빠른 속도로 타르타로스의 벽을 타고 아드리: (No sooner has she spoken than Shynic races up Tartaros's walls toward Adrica.)
I'm glad Lady Shynic is in better spirits. It's thanks to you, Adventurer.
strings.최근에 그 일 때문에 좀 우울해 하시는 것 같았는데, 한 번 칼리에 다녀: She seemed rather down after what happened recently, but she's been better since visiting Kali.
Thank you for telling her about the Curirings, too.
Please keep visiting Tartaros and bringing interesting things into her life. It takes quite a lot to amuse her these days.
strings.아, 샤이닉 님 말씀으로는 얼마 전에 마르스에 다녀오셨다구요?: Oh, Lady Shynic mentioned you visited Mars recently.
Yes, I had something to do there...
strings.언제 한 번 가봐야겠네요. 피오도 보고, 집사 모임도 한 번 해야 할 것: I should visit sometime. See Peo, and perhaps arrange another butlers' gathering...
I must excuse myself now. There are new items at the Hall of Heroes that need sorting. I'll see you later.
strings.흐음, 조금 기분이 이상한데…. 그냥 좀 쉬어야겠다. 요즘 들어 일이 많: Hmm. I feel a little strange... I should just rest. I've had so much to do lately. I'm tired.
